# 8 rumors we've fact-checked about Nobel Peace Prize nominations

## Yes, someone once nominated Adolf Hitler for the Nobel Peace Prize. No, Pope Leo XIV did not nominate Taylor Swift for the prestigious award.

### [Rae Deng](/author/rae-deng/)

### Published Aug. 23, 2025

![In this photo collage, three headshots are edited side-by-side: Taylor Swift, a white woman with blond hair in a red dress, Donald Trump, a tan white man with short blond hair, and Elon Musk, a white man wearing a black cap that says ](https://mediaproxy.snopes.com/width/1200/https://media.snopes.com/2025/08/nobel_peace_prize_collection.png)

 **Image courtesy of Getty Images/Snopes Illustration**

The Nobel Peace Prize is perhaps the most well-known, prestigious award in the world — which means controversial nominations, whether real or fake, can often cause a stir on the internet.

For example, Snopes has [confirmed](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/hitler-nominated-nobel-peace-prize/) that someone once nominated Adolf Hitler for the award, albeit for satirical reasons. However, we have also debunked a [claim](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/taylor-swift-pope-leo-nobel-prize/) that Pope Leo XIV nominated pop star Taylor Swift for the prize in 2025.

We also often look into claims around U.S. President Donald Trump's [efforts](https://www.politico.eu/article/donald-trump-called-norway-finance-minister-ask-about-nobel-peace-prize/) to [win](https://archive.ph/d4ynN) a Nobel Peace Prize, including a rumor that he threatened to bomb Norway if he did not receive the top diplomatic award. (The award ceremony [takes place](https://www.nobelprize.org/ceremonies/the-nobel-peace-prize-award-ceremony-2024/) in Norway.)

Here's eight fact-checks we have written about the peace prize annually awarded [for](https://www.nobelpeaceprize.org/nobel-peace-prize/about-the-nobel-peace-prize/) "the most or the best work for fraternity between nations, for the abolition or reduction of standing armies and for the holding and promotion of peace congresses."

[![]()

### Did 70K Cambodian monks nominate Trump for Nobel Peace Prize?

Aug. 21, 2025  Cambodia's Prime Minister Hun Manet nominated Trump for the Nobel Peace Prize on Aug. 7, 2025.

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-cambodian-monks-nobel-peace-prize/?collection=471017)

[![]()

### Trump didn't 'freak out' over question on Nobel Peace Prize application

Aug. 20, 2025  The Nobel Peace Prize isn't something you can simply apply for, anyhow.

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-freak-out-nobel-peace-prize/?collection=471017)

[![A white man wearing an all-white outfit stands behind a pulpit pictured next a white woman standing behind a microphone wearing a red dress.]()

### Taylor Swift was nominated by Pope Leo XIV for Nobel Peace Prize?

July 21, 2025  The deadline for 2025 Nobel Peace Prize nominations passed on Jan. 31.

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/taylor-swift-pope-leo-nobel-prize/?collection=471017)

[![]()

### Disproving claim Nobel Committee 'quietly removed' Trump from Peace Prize nominee list

Aug. 18, 2025  Nobel nominations stay secret for 50 years.

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-nobel-peace-prize-list/?collection=471017)

[![]()

### Nuking claim Trump threatened to bomb Norway if he didn't win Nobel Peace Prize

Aug. 4, 2025  The rumor reemerged online in early August 2025 after White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavi ...

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-bomb-norway-nobel-peace-prize-2/?collection=471017)

[![]()

### Yes, Elon Musk Was Nominated for Nobel Peace Prize. Here's Who Did It

Jan. 30, 2025  Branko Grims, a Slovenian member of the European Parliament, cited Musk's "support for the funda ...

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/musk-nominated-nobel-peace-prize/?collection=471017)

[![]()

### Hitler Was Once Nominated for Nobel Peace Prize?

Oct. 30, 2024  One social media user making the claim in October 2024 said: "They don't teach you that in publi ...

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/adolf-hitler-nobel-peace-prize/?collection=471017)

[![]()

### Was Trump Nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize?

Feb. 3, 2016  A trending Facebook topic led many to believe in 2016 that Donald Trump was slated to receive a ...

Read More](https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/trump-nominated-nobel-prize/?collection=471017)

# Will Taylor Swift win the Nobel Literature Prize someday?

[Sign up now:](/newsletter-signup?ref=inline-article) Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

[Jan Lee](/authors/jan-lee?ref=article-byline)and[Yamini Chinnuswamy](/authors/yamini-chinnuswamy?ref=article-byline)

Published Feb 23, 2024, 06:30 PM

Synopsis: Each month, The Straits Times examines the ins and outs of pop culture in the Asian entertainment and Hollywood scene.

American superstar Taylor Swift has dominated pop culture with her mega-successful Eras Tour, her historic fourth Grammy win for Album of the Year in 2024 and her fairytale-like romance with American football star Travis Kelce.

And she will soon be bringing her tour for a sold-out six-night show at National Stadium in Singapore from March 2-9. Ahead of her concert, #PopVultures host Jan Lee sits down for a throwback to her English-literature-student days.

Joining her in this episode to explore Swift’s multi-generational appeal, are Life correspondent and “Swiftie” Yamini Chinnuswamy, 15-year-old Gen-Z “Swiftie” Yvonne Inglin as well as Ravi Agarwal, a 51-year-old connoisseur of Swift’s lyrics.

Together, they discuss the literary value of her songs while Ravi also reads out the best of her lyrics. They analyse the appeal of her songs and how different songs reflect different periods in Swift’s life.

They spotlight three of Swift’s most famous songs from different eras of her career - Blank Space, Anti-Hero and All Too Well (10 Minute Version) - and talk about Swift’s use of metaphors, rhymes and sentence structure. They also talk about their own impressions of these songs and why it fascinates and appeals to them.

They also ponder the very important question: Is a Nobel Literature Prize in Swift’s future?

35:30 Rapid-fire Swiftie questions for Yvonne & Ravi
